candidates.topic: FDA nationwide recall of blood pressure medication (chlorthalidone) after failed dissolution testing
candidates.recommended_angle: What the failed dissolution test actually means for patients currently taking this medication — practical next-steps framing, not just recall-notice repetition.
candidates.why_now: Breaking today (WUSA9, 9/28); Google Trends 'Trending Now' confirms real-time breakout search interest tied to this exact story.
candidates.primary_headline: Blood Pressure Medication Recalled Nationwide — What 'Failed Dissolution Testing' Means for Patients
candidates.next_steps: Confirm FDA.gov enforcement notice directly (lot numbers, manufacturer, distribution scope) before publishing; do not rely solely on secondary coverage. Pull board-certified cardiologist or clinical pharmacist expert to explain dissolution-testing failure vs. contamination-based recalls.
integrity_flags: Confidence capped at Medium — primary FDA.gov notice not yet directly retrieved, verification via named outlets only. Confirm before copy locks.
candidates.trend_score_reason: Google Trends Trending Now breakout + 2 named tier-2 outlets (WUSA9, Good Housekeeping) same-day corroboration on failed dissolution testing.
candidates.opportunity_score_reason: Clear patient-safety angle with actionable guidance; high audience relevance to medication safety and health decision-making.
candidates.discover_score_reason: Breaking recall news with real-time search interest spike and actionable patient guidance makes this highly discoverable content.
candidates.notes: Breaking-recall exception applied. Primary FDA.gov notice unverified — must confirm before final publish. Do not stop taking medication abruptly messaging essential.

fact_check.checked_against: WUSA9 and Good Housekeeping headlines in Google News Radar; Google Trends 'Trending Now' entry for 'fda chlorthalidone dissolution testing recall' with Good Housekeeping sourcing

candidates.topic: Senate passes mental health reform bill for pilots and air traffic controllers
candidates.recommended_angle: Why pilots have historically hidden mental health struggles for fear of losing their license — and what this bill actually changes about disclosure and treatment access.
candidates.why_now: Senate passage 9/25 (Reuters, ALPA); Google Trends shows the bill name itself as a rising related query under 'mental health,' confirming real audience search interest beyond wire coverage.
candidates.primary_headline: Pilots Have Hidden Mental Health Struggles for Decades. A New Law Could Change That.
candidates.next_steps: Pull direct bill text/summary from congress.gov to confirm specific provisions (e.g., certification protections) rather than relying only on press coverage. Secure aviation medical examiner or occupational health psychologist expert.
integrity_flags: Borderline category pass — confirm bill provisions directly from congress.gov before final copy to avoid overstating scope.
candidates.trend_score_reason: Senate passage with dual-source corroboration (Reuters tier 1, ALPA tier 2) plus rising mental-health-related search queries confirm audience interest.
candidates.opportunity_score_reason: Clear health-equity angle addressing occupational mental-health stigma; broadly relevant to workplace wellness and healthcare access conversations.
candidates.discover_score_reason: Policy explainer with human-interest angle on hidden stigma; moderate discoverability as secondary health trend compared to breaking news.
candidates.notes: Borderline category call — passed audience-relevance and clear-health-angle criteria. Monitor for any partisan-opinion drift in framing. Bill provisions must be verified from congress.gov before publication.

issues: Headline's claim that pilots have 'hidden mental health struggles for decades' is a historical/causal framing not directly documented in the Reuters or ALPA coverage, which only confirm bill passage.
fact_check.checked_against: Reuters and ALPA headlines on Senate passage of pilot/ATC mental health legislation; Google Trends rising related queries 'pilot mental health bill' and 'john a. hauser mental health in aviation act' under mental health
